author: m4rine_semperfi
body:
I could not find the format so I did my best
IGN: m4rine_semperfi
Date of ban: 8/17/16
Date of unban: 8/24/16
Banned By: Junr

Reason: "Suicide Encouragement"

Extra info:

I said 'WOW LAG KILL, GO DIE' What? How did I encourage him to end his real life himself.
1) It's a game about killing people
2) I was mad for a second about your hosts lag, no one was mentally or physically hurt
3) Dying doesn't always equal suicide, but suicide equals death.
The situation was under control shortly after. 

Quote "
  1. Maintain a casual and positive atmosphere at all times. Be respectful of all players. Harassment and bullying are strictly not allowed."
I do agree I was being disrespectful to a player, but there is a command entitled /mute which can be used for chat rules broken. A 7 day ban for saying 2 words is like putting someone in Alcatraz for a month after stealing a bag of pencils at a store.

I would be glad to apologize to this player if he wants, and I do apologize to this server for my behavior. I shall note, though, that 2 players were spamming chat with caps and received no punishment, maybe even no warning...  I feel like this punishment system needs some work, if I do say so myself. 
Finally, my last point is that if someone is honestly offended by that they have never seen the internet. Get over it. Someone said 2 words against you and then stopped. I have been through real stuff in my life and have come no where close to getting offended on minecraft chat when people say things towards me. And also what the hell, who bans someone for a minor chat offense? Do you not do mutes on this server? I thought at the end of the day it was all about having fun pvping, not about nitpicking one insult in a game about murdering each other. Thank you for reading

We also do not have a mute plugin on the server.
